title: NCLT Hyderabad Sanctions MTAR Technologies' Merger With Two Wholly Owned Subsidiaries
case_name: In re: Scheme of Amalgamation of Gee Pee Aerospace and Defence Pvt. Ltd. and Magnatar Aero Systems Pvt. Ltd. with MTAR Technologies Ltd.
citation: Order dated 28 October 2026 on the joint company petition admitted 10 July 2026
card_summary: The Hyderabad Bench of the NCLT sanctioned the scheme merging MTAR Technologies' two wholly owned subsidiaries, Gee Pee Aerospace and Defence and Magnatar Aero Systems, into the parent company under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The scheme takes effect from the appointed date of 1 April 2025. Both transferor companies stand dissolved without winding up, and their assets and liabilities vest in MTAR.
card_tip: Settle the appointed date and dissolution terms upfront in a wholly owned subsidiary scheme; sanction can lag well behind that date, so plan integration steps around the gap.
verification_notes: Confirmed by two independent reports (Investywise, Arthneeti) citing the company's exchange filing; the order's own text was not accessed, and one source names the bench as 'Hyderabad Bench-II' while the other says only 'Hyderabad Bench'.
